properties.originalText:
A RESTRICTED AREA NAMED BIR10, IS DEFINED BY DIRECT LINE
BETWEEN LITLA SKOGARFELL 63552709N022220063W, KEILIR
63563027N022101228W, KLEIFARVATN 63541461N021593320W, HUSHOLMI
63495123N022101737W, RAS (GRINDAVIK) 63495500N022273600W, BLUE
LAGOON PARKING LOT 63525800N022272400W.
UPPER LIMIT: 2000 FEET AMSL. LOWER LIMIT:
GND. PLUS VFR ROUTE 7 BETWEEN BIRK AND BIR10 VIA GARDAKIRKJA DCT
ALVER DCT KEILIR AT 2000 FEET FOR HELICOPTERS AND 1500 FEET FOR
FIXED WING AIRCRAFT. CONTACT REYKJAVIK OR KEFLAVIK TOWER FOR
PERMISSION TO ENTER THE AREA. RESTRICTIONS:
TRANSPONDER. AIR TO AIR COMMUNICATIONS 131.800 MHZ. FOR FURTHER
INFORMATION SEE SUP 13/2025.
